overview_description.description:
Orum is the simplest API for fast, reliable payments. Orum’s API solution delivers access to all major rails – RTP, FedNow, Same Day ACH, ACH, and Wires – and now instant bank account verification. Orum allows businesses to launch instant payments and instant bank account verification in just days, without costly bank integrations or prolonged compliance. This in turn empowers businesses and banks to launch new payment experiences that attract and monetize more customers.

Founded by Stephany Kirkpatrick and led by expert fintech operators from LearnVest, Square, N26, Klarna, Marqeta, and Stash, Orum has raised over $82M from leading investors, including Accel, Canapi, Bain Capital Ventures, Inspired Capital, Homebrew, Acrew, BoxGroup, Clocktower Ventures, Primary Ventures and American Express Ventures. We provide the technology and expertise required to power a better financial system where everyone has the freedom to build to their potential. To learn more, visit Orum.io.

product.name: Deliver API
product.description: An API that enables businesses to send payments 24/7 via multiple payment rails including FedNow, RTP, Same Day ACH, ACH, Wires, and Visa Direct with bank-rate pricing and expanded processing windows.

product.name: Verify by Orum
product.description: A technology that instantly verifies U.S. bank account status, ownership, and control for both business and consumer accounts, covering 100% of U.S. bank accounts.

product.name: Orum Portal and Ledger
product.description: A custom-built portal and ledger for real-time monitoring, orchestration, and optimization of payment operations including reconciliation, reporting, and user management.

product.name: No Code Payment Solution
product.description: A solution allowing businesses to send payments and manage transfers by uploading Nacha files without requiring engineering resources or API integration.

product.name: Payment Use Cases Support
product.description: Support for specific payment use cases including billing, lending, disbursements, brokerage, and creator payments to optimize money movement and payment certainty.
